name: B10-0057/2026 – After § 5 – Am 7
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the murder of Mehdi Kessaci: urgent need for ambitious European action against drug trafficking
part_text: 5a. Recalls that the new anti-drug strategy calls on the Member States to adopt zero-tolerance policies on driving under the influence of drugs, in accordance with Directive 2006/126/EC on driving licences1a, and to make full use of the cross-border tools available to enforce these rules; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Directive 2006/126/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 December 2006 on driving licences (OJ L 403, 30.12.2006, p. 18, ELI: [http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2006/126/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2006/126/oj)).
